tools.name: check_ai_built_app
tools.description: Reads the public pages and public JavaScript of a web app (typically built with Lovable, Bolt, v0, Replit or similar) and reports exposed API keys, public source maps, missing security headers, stale deploys, missing error monitoring and AI model calls made from the browser. tools.name: diagnose_shopify_store
tools.description: Reads the public pages of a Shopify store and reports whether it offers social login and a wishlist, how many products show as sold out, and whether it runs storefronts for several countries. Reads only public pages.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "site-check" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_site_email_security · Private data: check_site_email_security, check_ai_built_app · Public sink: check_site_email_security.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_site_email_security · Private data: check_site_email_security, check_ai_built_app · Public sink: check_site_email_security

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
